title: Teach People, "This Is My Straight Path." - The Way of Allah
body:
Madad, yaa Sultanu 'l-Awliya. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illaLlah Muhammadun Rasoolullah, `alayhi salaatullah from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Madad, yaa Rijaalallah. I am Your weak servant. O my Lord! And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ashShaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. That gives us honor and it is His stamp, stamp of the
king, His seal. We are weak servants. O our Lord, support Your weak servants. You have Endless Dominions.
You have Endless Oceans in each dominion. You are the Lord of Creation!!! We are nothing, but You granted
us such an honor, and You said, O our Lord: (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
•••••• ••••• ••••••• ••••••••••••••• •••••• ••••••• ••• •••••••• •••••••••
Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. Wa idha qaala rabbuka lil-malaa`ikati innee ja`eelun fi'l-`ardi khalifah.
And when your Lord said to the angels, "Verily I am making in the Earth a deputy.” (al-Baqarah, 2:30)
Allah! Allah! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
O our listeners in the east and west! O our attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum! That heavenly salute is reaching
to servants and bringing to them heavenly blessings. Therefore, it is something urged by the Seal of Prophets,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (Mawlana Shaykh stands), to say, "As-salaamu `alaykum." (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)

Madad, O our guide who is responsible for everything happening on this planet. O People! Send to that one
your salutes, "As-salaamu `alaykum, yaa Saahibu 'l-Imdaad," director of everything on this planet,
everywhere. Because if heavenly support and heavenly blessings do not reach someone, it is impossible to be
in existence. this is an important point.
O Muslim `ulamas from Ahlu’l-Sunnah, Ahlu' l-Shi`a, and Salafi `ulamas! It is such an important point.
Everything in existence, without looking at their greatness or smallness, can't be in existence, so that
everything on this planet, from biggest one to smallest one, must reach direct support from heavens, to reach
that one, then it is going to appear in existence. We may say the whole world is in need of its greatness, taking
its share, but on it and in it countless beings are just taking its saf, ranks, and tarteeb, orders. For example,
here we are sitting and everyone has a special place and a measure on it. Do you think the smallest thing is an
atom? Do you think atoms are choosing their private stations by themselves, or is Some One putting one after
one after one? The Lord of Heavens is al-`azhamatu lillah, Glorious Greatness is for Allah Almighty!!
O People living in the 21st century! You don't think you must try to know heavenly knowledge from heavenly
books. You say, "Just we find elements." Yes. You must think because Allah Almighty is saying, •••••••••••
•••••••••••••• la`alahum yatafakkaroon, "That perchance they may reflect." (al-`Araaf, 7:176) Allah Almighty
is asking this from chosen creatures who have been honored to be deputies of the Lord of Heavens. Where
are the deputies? You must think on it. Who has been chosen to be Allah Almighty's deputies?
O `Ulamas! Do you think we have been supported with such a knowledge that belongs to heavens to wake up
all people? an-naasu niyaam, people have been sleeping! "Sleeping" means that they have been closing their
eyes to see and look at reality. And beyond that reality are countless realities and they are saying, "We have
reached the top point of knowledge.” And Allah Almighty is sending them to see things they have never been
thinking on. People are drunk, but the Lord of Heavens is now sending heavenly bombardings on their
mindly productions.
O People! It is enough to be drunk; don't also be heedless! Wake up and look beyond that limit, where there
are unlimited horizons! You have reached only a material horizon and you are getting so proud, claiming
that, “We are reaching the top point.” You may be reaching the top point of a material horizon, but from
where is that material horizon coming? Don't say, "From the Big Bang." That is foolishness, (an invention of)

no-mind people, such a nonsense claim, because Shaytan is their teacher, saying, “When people think about
the beginning and ending of this world, we must fill their attention and occupy their minds with something
useless (to confuse them)." And people are now saying, "We have reached the top point of civilization and
technologia." What are they thinking? Only two-hundred years ago no one knew about technology coming in
existence. You can say, “This is the horizon of technology, and its next horizon can't be beyond that.”
Shaytan is teaching them, “Use these useless theories that the mind is never accepting, put there to occupy
peoples' minds endlessly." They use theories, which is not reality!!! But the real aim is to occupy people on
that theory, the Big Bang, that it was only one atom exploding, and in one-billionth of a second coming this
and going that. And now, everywhere, I am sorry to say that our Muslim countries are also putting this in
their books and teaching it as a real knowledge. It is a nonsense theory that this huge universe is coming from
one atom! What is that foolishness? They are putting in their (curricula) and teaching to youngsters, making
them believe that, and not teaching them to believe that this whole huge universe is coming from the Lord of
Heavens!!! I am sorry, but on them is coming cursing from Unseen Territories, because they left the True
Way and diverted on wrong ways.
The Lord of Heavens said, (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) inna hadha siraat al-mustaqeema, "This is My Straight
Path.” (Mawlana Shakyh sits.)
O `ulamas, why are you not saying, inna hadha siraat al-mustaqeema? I am asking `ulamas, Salafi `ulamas,
and Shi`a `ulamas, what is that siraat; from where it comes and to where it goes? Do you know? If you know,
why are you not teaching people? ••••••• •••••• •••••••• •••••••••••• inna hadha siraatee mustaqeema, Verily,
this is My way, leading straight: (6:153) Allah Almighty is saying, "This is My Straight Way, siraatee, My Way.
Who is asking to reach to Me--to know, to learn, to be, to understand--this is the Way." Laa `iwaja lah, "No
crookedness is found in it," also ayat ul-kareemah, yes, you know but you are not using. What is mustaqeema
and what is crooked way? Why are you not saying? Why are you following western philosophers' ideas and
leaving holy books that are trying to teach you about your beginning and ending and about yourself? Why are
you not teaching? You only know to swear on someone like me, who is nothing? Because sometimes they are
making me to shout on you and your egos are getting so angry! Don't get angry, because then heavenly
lightenings are coming on your heads, then you are finished, disappeared! Is that a solution for every
problem for people living in the 21st century? You know only to swear, “That one is nothing.” You are getting

angry and unrest from such words, and muta`aajib, you are astonishing from what I am bringing. I am not
bringing; they are sending, and I am only the weakest servant!
Why are you getting angry? No, I am only bringing an answer. If you know it is true, you are accepting.
Prophet Muhammad (s) is saying, (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) •••• ••••• ••••••• innama 'l-`ilmu bi't-ta`allum,
"Verily knowledge is by learning.” (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Yes, is it true or not? Ta`allum is knowledge going to be learned by a teacher. If there is no teacher, no one is
learning anything. Prophet (s) says, innama 'l-`ilmu bi ta`allum, knowledge that belongs to heavenly
stations, that is the siraat, the Way to heavens. Why are you not using it? Why are you not giving a meaning
about that knowledge? Why are you not asking about that knowledge? Why are you having such envy? And
Allah Almighty is saying, "(The value of) dunya is less than the wing of a mosquito."
O People! Wake up! Don't be enemies with such a person that is never claiming anything for himself, only
asking to be accepted as a servant of the Lord of Heavens, Allah Almighty! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah Sultaan Allah.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
O Muslim governments! You are only happy to teach your youngsters the national anthem. I am also saying
to all kings, queens, sultans, they are only teaching the national anthem. You are so careful (about that), and
some countries now have a law that if their national anthem is playing and someone remains sitting and not
standing up, they take him to prison. But when adhaan al-Muhammadi (s) (the Islamic call to prayer) is
heard, they are never taking any care! Why all presidents, majesties, kings, soldiers, or civilians are not taking
care when the heavenly anthem is playing? Do you think that Allah Almighty and all angels are not looking at
you? And so when adhaan al-Muhammadi (s) is playing, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) people must stand up,
even if it is called five times or fifty times a day! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) That is Islamic good manners! You
must keep it! Even kings or queens, when adhaan al-Muhammadi is called five times, make a trumpet so

people know adhaan al-Muhammadi is calling now. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
May Allah forgive us! We are such wrong people and useless servants! Allah Almighty grants us countless
favors and we are not taking any care to give at least an honor to azaan al-Muhammadi (s). (Mawlana Shaykh
stands.) Stand up! Even if for one moment, it is enough. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) You make your Lord happy
with you and He grants you a dress of honor, He dresses on you heavenly lights, saying, "My servant is giving
his full respect for My Holy Name!"
O our Lord, forgive us! We are sinners, we are sinners! Send us someone to teach us the way of heavens. May
Allah (swt) forgive us. Tawbah yaa Rabbee! Tawbah yaa Rabbee! Tawbah yaa Rabbee!
Fatihah.

We are only asking for the heavenly lights of our Lord, to make You happy with us. That is our real aim, that
You, Allah Almighty, are pleased with us.
O People! Try to make Allah (swt) pleased with you! May Allah forgive me and you.
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Shaykh Hisham Effendi and Hajjah Naziha on the phone.)
(42 minutes)
